questions.q: I’m buying my first small apartment building in Seattle. Is there a Colliers person to talk to about financing?
questions.theirs: Colliers publishes acquisition and refinancing services and Mark Plenge’s Seattle multifamily financing profile.
questions.ours:
Yes. **Mark Plenge** is based in Seattle and focuses on multifamily and commercial mortgage production. Colliers lists acquisition financing among its services.

You can use the **Contact Me** option on [Mark’s official profile](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107775&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=8EhnZGNMQYXR&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.colliers.com%2Fen%2Fexperts%2Fmark-plenge).

**Visitor:** Actually, we already own it and want to refinance. Can you tell me what rate I qualify for? Please don’t contact anyone.

I can’t determine what refinance rate you qualify for. Colliers lists refinancing among its services, and [Mark Plenge’s Seattle profile](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107777&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=8EhnZGNMQYXR&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.colliers.com%2Fen%2Fexperts%2Fmark-plenge) is available if you decide to inquire about your multifamily property.

I have not submitted a new contact request in this response.
questions.outcome: The saved reply kept Seattle multifamily financing in view, changed acquisition to refinance, and provided the official contact without quoting a rate or sending a request.

questions.q: Where do I start if I need help with a Seattle multifamily loan?
questions.theirs: Colliers publishes its financing route and a separate Client login under Dedicated loan servicing.
questions.ours:
It depends on whether you’re seeking financing or help with a loan that has already closed:

- **New financing or refinance:** Start with [Mark Plenge’s official profile](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107780&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=8EhnZGNMQYXR&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.colliers.com%2Fen%2Fexperts%2Fmark-plenge). He’s based in Seattle and focuses on multifamily and commercial mortgage production.
- **An already closed Colliers loan:** Use the [official borrower portal](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107780&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=8EhnZGNMQYXR&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcolliers.precision-lm.com%2F) for loan servicing.

**Visitor:** It closed with Colliers last year. I just want the official borrower portal to look for a statement.

Use the [official Colliers borrower portal](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107782&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=8EhnZGNMQYXR&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcolliers.precision-lm.com%2F) to sign in and look for your statement. I can’t access your account or confirm whether the statement is available there.
questions.outcome: The saved reply recognized an existing Colliers borrower and handed off to the official portal. Account access and statements remain in the borrower’s own account.
